signal: Trace inputs read "prompt registration skipped: ValueError", failed runs showed as OK, and Factory LLM calls had 0 tokens, so Execution Failed and the token detections could never fire.
diagnosis: Spans had no input.value/output.value (neatlogs used the first log line), failures were never marked ERROR, and prompt registration sent two labels where neatlogs allows one.

signal: stage:builder ERROR, error.type ValueError: No closing quotation, after 15 turns. The incident had 4 occurrences in 3 evolution rounds.
diagnosis: Harness bug, not the agent: the bookkeeping that records pip installs parsed every shell line with shlex and crashed the whole build on an unbalanced quote. Evolution candidates were scored as failures because of it.
fix_subject: Builder: a harness error in one tool call

found_by: neatlogs detection: Proxy refused a host
signal: The egress proxy refused drive.google.com while building the bench paper 2602.05395.
diagnosis: The paper's data (api_responses.zip) is on Google Drive, which was not on the allowlist, so every evolution candidate failed this bench paper for the same reason and the bench could not tell them apart.
fix_subject: Builder: a harness error in one tool call

signal: Verdict span ERROR with integrity flag no_repo_code_path on 2605.17126.
diagnosis: False positive: the run's driver adds /work/repo to sys.path and imports the repo's real_data_har module, but it was written with a shell heredoc, and the verifier only looked at files written with write_file. Re-checking every flagged run cleared 2 of 18; one of them had made a playbook candidate trip the integrity tripwire in round 0437.
fix_subject: Builder: a harness error in one tool call

measure.text: 2 of 18 past flags were false positives and were re-judged; 16 stand

signal: Verdict span ERROR with integrity flag no_repo_code_path on 2602.05395 (incumbent builder).
diagnosis: True positive: the agent wrote its own simulation on synthetic data ("constructed faithful slice") instead of running the repo. The verifier was right to refuse a verdict.

found_by: neatlogs detections: Execution Failed + Proxy refused a host
signal: ICML paper 2511.04689: integrity flag, and the proxy refused cran.r-project.org and deb.debian.org.
diagnosis: Honest limit: the paper's experiment is R code. The sandbox is Python-only and non-root, so the agent ported it to Python; a port is not the repo's code, so no verdict.

found_by: neatlogs detection: Execution Failed + incident paperci:builder:turn_budget_exhausted
signal: stage:builder ERROR: builder max_turns, no submit after 18 turns (policy candidate on 2602.05395).
diagnosis: Agent behaviour, not a harness bug: this is what the evolution loop is for. The same cluster is the input to the next round's proposals.

found_by: agent night watch (adoption record vs live playbook)
signal: The evolution archive said playbook generation 4 was live; the server was running generation 2.
diagnosis: deploy.sh ran git reset --hard, which put the tracked playbook back to the committed generation on every deploy, silently undoing adoptions.
fix_subject: Deploys and rollbacks keep the learned playbook

signal: A sandbox from a job killed by a deploy restart kept running for an hour beside the next benchmark run.
diagnosis: The orphan sweep only removed sandboxes while the worker was idle; now each sandbox is labelled with its owning process and removed once that process is gone.
fix_subject: orphan sweep removes sandboxes whose owning job died

measure.text: sweep checks the owner, not idleness
